reels.caption:
This tour happened because I have the best followers on Insta ♥️
Storytime: @kavitagenomal noticed I was in New York through my stories — reached out and connected the dots so I could film this home tour for all of you! This reel came to life because of you - thank you! 😘

This penthouse sits in Central Park Tower and spans three entire floors — over 17,500 sq ft of thoughtfully designed luxury.

It's also the highest residential apartment in the world. Not Burj Khalifa (turns out that's mixed-use!). I only recently found that out too.

Catch the whole HOME TOUR on YouTube. Link is in the bio!

Inside, there are:
• 7 bedrooms
• 8.5 bathrooms
• 2 kitchens, including a full catering kitchen
• A double-height living area with 21 ft ceilings
• And full-length windows with views of Central Park and the Empire State Building

The primary suite faces the entire Central Park skyline — and MY FAVOURITE- the building has a stabilising pendulum in the basement to soften the sway caused by wind at that height!

Would you live here if you had $200 million?

gabrieletonini thank you for showing me around the penthouse!!

reels.caption:
Would You Trade Your City Life For This Winter Cabin?

Footprints in the snow.
A stone path to a warm light.
Smoke rising into the mountains.

Inside: fire crackling, stone walls, coffee steaming.
Cinnamon rolls on the table.
Books, blankets, and zero rush.

Upstairs: a bed with snow-covered peaks outside the window.
Downstairs: a stone bathtub with candles while it snows.

We keep running for "more".
But peace looks exactly like this.

If you could disappear here for one month...
who would you bring with you? 🤍
